title: 728. Longest Word in Dictionary

examples.explanation: Each prefix of world appears, so the full word is buildable and longest.
Both apple and apply are buildable at length 5; apple is alphabetically smaller.
No single-letter word exists, so nothing is buildable.

hints: A word is buildable exactly when every one of its prefixes occurs in the set.
Check words from longest to shortest (ties alphabetically) and return the first buildable one, or sort ascending and track the best.
A trie also works, but a hash set of words plus prefix scans is simplest.
